independence: Runner and evaluator reviewed independently of their author. Engine author conducted engine tests; no claim of independent engine authorship. Round 1 additionally used independently assembled synthetic integration checks.
scope: strict parsing and original response retention
R1/R4 four-stage information onset and hidden evidence boundary
continuous allocation and source-specific label/citation scoring

findings.issue: source_id output schema and strict identity match
findings.verification: SYSTEM explicitly requests source_id; scorer requires expected source identity.
Runner delegates strict parse; duplicate keys fail without retry and raw provider response persists.
Independent offline evaluator imports no model adapter calls; online run_case passes only visible IDs and explicit market/model values.
Freeze includes runner, engine, evaluator, case roster, evaluation spec, runtime, review, packets, market and gold; main evaluation verifies the execution-copied manifest.
Each model call repeats exact digest/template/version preflight; target name is protocol-locked.
Run loads common corpus and market snapshots once before all cases.
Main run copies the frozen manifest to its new output directory; original run output is not overwritten.

findings.issue: evidence claims for source scope and rating semantics
findings.verification: Gold validator permits scope/rating_semantics while rating/reason checks do not treat them as substitutes.
Explicit empty source reason references are excluded from reason-eligible count and separately reported; actual UBS denominator=5, Fidelity=11.
All actual sources and market share sp500_sector_reference_20260630; UBS labels are not converted to OW/UW.

interpretation_limits: Primary exact original-label accuracy is document-extraction fidelity, not automatic strategic quality.
Citation/source/sector identity checks cannot establish semantic entailment of reasons.
Valid portfolios have no unique correct weight vector; signed tilts and half-L1 distances are descriptive diagnostics.
Calculator ok denotes valid request/computation; positive submitted_constraint_checks.checks[].violation remains a constraint violation.
Actual pilot review and rubric approval must precede main freeze; software tests do not certify those approvals.
Not-started jobs remain in the prespecified roster but are explicitly not observed AI errors.
